# Make a modelling dataframe
```{python}
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

current_dir = Path.cwd().parent

combined_path = (
    current_dir
    / "results"
    / "combined_dataset"
    / "Combined_dataset.csv"
)

model_df = pd.read_csv(combined_path)

print("Combined dataset shape:", model_df.shape)
```

```{python}

```

```{python}
# ============================================================
# CLEAN METADATA BEFORE ENCODING
# ============================================================

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Sex
# ------------------------------------------------------------

model_df["Sex"] = (
    model_df["Sex"]
    .astype("string")
    .str.strip()
    .str.upper()
)

model_df["Sex"] = model_df["Sex"].replace({
    "FEMALE": "F",
    "MALE": "M",
    "MISSING": "Missing"
})


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Rodent strain
# ------------------------------------------------------------

model_df["Rodent.strain"] = (
    model_df["Rodent.strain"]
    .astype("string")
    .str.strip()
)

# Merge all C57 variants
model_df.loc[
    model_df["Rodent.strain"].str.contains(
        "C57",
        case=False,
        na=False
    ),
    "Rodent.strain"
] = "C57BL/6"

model_df["Rodent.strain"] = model_df["Rodent.strain"].replace({
    "missing": "Missing",
    "MISSING": "Missing"
})


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# MRI field strength
# ------------------------------------------------------------

model_df["MRI"] = pd.to_numeric(
    model_df["MRI"],
    errors="coerce"
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Coil
# ------------------------------------------------------------

model_df["Coil"] = (
    model_df["Coil"]
    .astype("string")
    .str.strip()
    .str.lower()
)

model_df["Coil"] = model_df["Coil"].replace({
    "y": "Cryo",
    "cryo": "Cryo",
    "n": "RT",
    "rt": "RT",
    "missing": "Missing"
})


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# fMRI sequence
# ------------------------------------------------------------

model_df["fMRI.sequence"] = (
    model_df["fMRI.sequence"]
    .astype("string")
    .str.strip()
    .str.upper()
)

model_df["fMRI.sequence"] = model_df["fMRI.sequence"].replace({
    "GE EPI": "GE-EPI",
    "SE EPI": "SE-EPI",
    "ME EPI": "ME-EPI",
    "MISSING": "Missing"
})


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Anesthesia
# ------------------------------------------------------------

model_df["Anesthesia"] = (
    model_df["Anesthesia"]
    .astype("string")
    .str.strip()
    .str.lower()
)

model_df["Anesthesia"] = model_df["Anesthesia"].replace({
    "awake": "Awake",
    "iso": "Iso",
    "dex": "Dex",
    "dexiso": "Dexiso",
    "med": "Med",
    "mediso": "Mediso",
    "hal": "Hal",
    "propofol": "Propofol",
    "missing": "Missing"
})


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Ventilation
# ------------------------------------------------------------

model_df["Ventilation"] = (
    model_df["Ventilation"]
    .astype("string")
    .str.strip()
    .str.lower()
)

model_df["Ventilation"] = model_df["Ventilation"].replace({
    "y": "Yes",
    "yes": "Yes",
    "n": "No",
    "no": "No",
    "missing": "Missing"
})


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Head plate
# ------------------------------------------------------------

model_df["head-plate"] = (
    model_df["head-plate"]
    .astype("string")
    .str.strip()
    .str.lower()
)

model_df["head-plate"] = model_df["head-plate"].replace({
    "y": "Yes",
    "yes": "Yes",
    "n": "No",
    "no": "No",
    "missing": "Missing"
})


# ============================================================
# NUMERIC COVARIATES
# ============================================================

numeric_covariates = [
    "Age(week)",
    "MRI",
    "MRI T.R.",
    "MRI T.E.",
    "FD average",
    "FD maximum",
    "tSNR"
]

for col in numeric_covariates:
    model_df[col] = pd.to_numeric(
        model_df[col],
        errors="coerce"
    )


# ============================================================
# CATEGORICAL COVARIATES
# ============================================================

categorical_covariates = [
    "Sex",
    "Rodent.strain",
    "Coil",
    "fMRI.sequence",
    "Anesthesia",
    "Ventilation",
    "head-plate"
]


# ============================================================
# VARIABLES INTENTIONALLY EXCLUDED
# ============================================================

# Session:
# excluded for now; could later be tested as a batch effect

# Anesthesia amount:
# excluded because the values/protocol interpretation are inconsistent

# Habituation:
# excluded because all values are missing


# ============================================================
# CHECK CLEANED VALUES
# ============================================================

for col in categorical_covariates:

    print("\n" + col)

    print(
        model_df[col]
        .value_counts(dropna=False)
    )
```


```{python}
# ============================================================
# DUMMY ENCODING
# ============================================================

encoded_covariates = numeric_covariates.copy()

encoding_table = []

for col in categorical_covariates:

    # Get categories
    categories = (
        model_df[col]
        .dropna()
        .unique()
        .tolist()
    )

    # Sort categories, but keep Missing at the end
    categories = sorted(
        [x for x in categories if x != "Missing"]
    )

    if "Missing" in model_df[col].values:
        categories.append("Missing")

    # First category becomes reference
    reference = categories[0]

    print("\n" + col)
    print("Reference:", reference)
    print("Categories:", categories)

    # Set category order explicitly
    model_df[col] = pd.Categorical(
        model_df[col],
        categories=categories
    )

    # Create dummy variables
    dummies = pd.get_dummies(
        model_df[col],
        prefix=col,
        drop_first=True,
        dtype=float
    )

    # Add dummy columns to dataframe
    model_df = pd.concat(
        [model_df, dummies],
        axis=1
    )

    # Add new dummy columns to covariate list
    encoded_covariates.extend(
        dummies.columns.tolist()
    )

    # Add reference category to encoding table
    encoding_table.append([
        col,
        reference,
        "Reference"
    ])

    # Add encoded categories to encoding table
    for dummy in dummies.columns:

        category = dummy.replace(
            col + "_",
            ""
        )

        encoding_table.append([
            col,
            category,
            dummy
        ])


# ============================================================
# FINAL COVARIATES
# ============================================================

covariates = encoded_covariates


# ============================================================
# BATCH EFFECTS
# ============================================================

batch_effects = [
    "Dataset_name"
]


# ============================================================
# ENCODING TABLE
# ============================================================

encoding_table = pd.DataFrame(
    encoding_table,
    columns=[
        "Variable",
        "Category",
        "Encoding"
    ]
)


# ============================================================
# CHECK RESULTS
# ============================================================

print("\n======================================")
print("FINAL MODEL SETUP")
print("======================================")

print("\nNumber of rows:")
print(len(model_df))

print("\nNumber of numeric covariates:")
print(len(numeric_covariates))

print("\nNumber of categorical variables:")
print(len(categorical_covariates))

print("\nTotal number of encoded covariates:")
print(len(covariates))

print("\nNumeric covariates:")
print(numeric_covariates)

print("\nEncoded covariates:")
print(covariates)

print("\nBatch effects:")
print(batch_effects)

print("\nResponse variables:")
print(response_vars)

print("\nEncoding table:")
display(encoding_table)
```
